description: Final six-panel provenance figure for the AP-64 antimicrobial mechanism-class analysis, with corrected panel layout
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, math
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size":9,"axes.spines.top":False,"axes.spines.right":False})
AMP=pd.read_csv("uniprot_amp_reference_set.csv"); FACE=pd.read_csv("amphipathic_face_charge.csv")
AP64="DDKPDKPDDKPDDSGKDPKPDFPKFLSLLGTEIIENAVEFILRSMSRSTGFMEFDDNEGKHSSK"
EISEN={'A':0.62,'R':-2.53,'N':-0.78,'D':-0.90,'C':0.29,'Q':-0.85,'E':-0.74,'G':0.48,'H':-0.40,
       'I':1.38,'L':1.06,'K':-1.50,'M':0.64,'F':1.19,'P':0.12,'S':-0.18,'T':-0.05,'W':0.81,'Y':0.26,'V':1.08}
CH={'K':1,'R':1,'H':0.1,'D':-1,'E':-1}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,11))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,12,hspace=0.75,wspace=2.6,left=.07,right=.97,top=.94,bottom=.06)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0:8])
ax.hist(AMP.net_q,bins=60,color="#9aa6b2",edgecolor="white",linewidth=.3)
ax.axvline(-6.10,color="#c0392b",lw=2.2)
ax.annotate("AP-64\n(C5orf46)\n-6.1, 1.5th pct",(-6.1,165),(-13,150),color="#c0392b",fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"))
for nm,v,c,yy in [("LL-37 / cecropin-A  +5.9",5.86,"#2471a3",120),("magainin-2  +2.9",2.90,"#2471a3",190),("Bac7  +10.9",10.86,"#117a65",70)]:
    ax.axvline(v,color=c,lw=1.1,ls="--"); ax.text(v+0.7,yy,nm,color=c,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge at pH 7.4"); ax.set_ylabel("number of peptides")
ax.set_title("A   AP-64 against 1,451 annotated mature AMPs (UniProt reviewed, keyword KW-0929)",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,8:12])
labs=["net charge","charge density","max hydrophobic\nmoment (w=18)"]; vals=[1.5,3.5,90.9]
ax.barh(labs,vals,color=["#c0392b","#c0392b","#1e8449"]); ax.axvline(50,color="k",lw=.7,ls=":")
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(v+2.5,i,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,112); ax.set_xlabel("percentile within AMP reference set")
ax.set_title("B   Descriptor percentiles",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0:8]); w=9; pos=np.arange(1,65)
locq=np.array([sum(CH.get(r,0) for r in AP64[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]) for i in range(64)])
loch=np.array([np.mean([EISEN[r] for r in AP64[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]]) for i in range(64)])
ax.axvspan(1,22,color="#c0392b",alpha=.08); ax.axvspan(30,47,color="#196f3d",alpha=.12)
ax.fill_between(pos,0,locq,where=locq>=0,color="#2471a3",alpha=.7)
ax.fill_between(pos,0,locq,where=locq<0,color="#c0392b",alpha=.7)
ax.set_ylim(-8,5.2); ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6)
ax2=ax.twinx(); ax2.plot(pos,loch,color="#196f3d",lw=1.8); ax2.spines.top.set_visible(False); ax2.set_ylim(-1.15,0.95)
ax.text(11.5,-5.2,"acidic, Pro-rich, disordered N-half\nnet -4.1, 23% Pro, 0 Arg\nAlphaFold pLDDT 54",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#7b241c")
ax.text(38.5,-5.2,"amphipathic helix\nGTEIIENAVEFILRSMSR\nuH 0.60, pLDDT 75",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#145a32")
ax.set_xlabel("residue in mature AP-64 (precursor 24-87)"); ax.set_ylabel("local net charge (9-residue window)")
ax2.set_ylabel("mean Eisenberg hydrophobicity",color="#196f3d")
ax.set_title("C   AP-64 is bipartite: an acidic disordered N-half and a hydrophobic amphipathic C-half",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,8:12])
short=[p.split(" best")[0].split(" (")[0] for p in FACE.peptide]
ax.barh(short,FACE.polar_face_charge,color=["#c0392b" if v<0.5 else "#2471a3" for v in FACE.polar_face_charge])
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8); ax.set_xlabel("charge on the polar, membrane-contacting face")
ax.set_title("D   Helical-wheel face charge\n      of each peptide's best window",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0:5])
ax.scatter(AMP.meanH,AMP.uH18,s=4,color="#ccd3da")
for k,(x,y,c) in {"AP-64":(-0.219,0.602,"#c0392b"),"LL-37":(-0.306,0.894,"#2471a3"),"magainin-2":(0.173,0.506,"#2471a3"),
     "cecropin-A":(0.037,0.658,"#2471a3"),"DCD-1L":(0.065,0.564,"#e67e22"),"Bac7":(-0.489,0.569,"#117a65"),
     "PR-39":(-0.329,0.379,"#117a65")}.items():
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=62,color=c,edgecolor="k",lw=.5,zorder=3); ax.annotate(k,(x,y),(5,5),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("mean hydrophobicity <H>"); ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment uH")
ax.set_title("E   Eisenberg amphipathicity plot",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,5:12])
ax.scatter(AMP.net_q,AMP.uH18,s=4,color="#ccd3da")
for k,(x,y,c) in {"AP-64":(-6.10,0.602,"#c0392b"),"LL-37":(5.86,0.894,"#2471a3"),"magainin-2":(2.90,0.506,"#2471a3"),
    "cecropin-A":(5.86,0.658,"#2471a3"),"histatin-3":(5.12,0.251,"#8e44ad"),"DCD-1L":(-2.10,0.564,"#e67e22"),
    "Bac7":(10.86,0.569,"#117a65"),"PR-39":(9.86,0.379,"#117a65")}.items():
    ax.scatter(x,y,s=70,color=c,edgecolor="k",lw=.5,zorder=3); ax.annotate(k,(x,y),(6,5),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8.5)
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.9,ls="--"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.12)
ax.text(-9,1.05,"anionic",fontsize=9,color="#c0392b"); ax.text(1.2,1.05,"cationic",fontsize=9,color="#2471a3")
ax.set_xlabel("net charge at pH 7.4"); ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment uH")
ax.set_title("F   AP-64 is amphipathic, yet it lies on the anionic side of the charge axis\n      that all membrane-lytic host-defence peptides share",loc="left",fontweight="bold")
plt.show()
